_about: What the Discovered panel lists: things on the bus whose kinds (a protocol that saw them, the scanner's kind segment or their device_class) contain one of these words, case-insensitive: the panels and surfaces a layout can be bound to. Tunables only: source holds no device list. An empty list shows everything.
_measured: Bench broker 2026-11-04 (ROAD-3502). 'midi' confirmed: protocol midi, device_class 'MIDI Interface' (e.g. midi/Device/Output/Dev1/name 'Arturia MicroLab:Arturia MicroLab  28:0'). 'hid' is PLUGIN.SPACENAVIGATOR's BareMetal target (HID), 'unavailable' on the bench, so nothing matches it today. 'touch', 'panel' and 'surface' were dropped: no plugin publishes a protocol, kind or device_class with those words (a device's own panel is Gui/Panels/<key>, which this builder reads by itself).
_about_panel_wait_ms: How long the builder, opened from a device's link, waits for that device's retained Gui/Panels/<key> before starting from its api.json instead. Retained panels arrive on connect, so this only runs out when the device presents none.
_about_broker_urls: The broker run.html dials when it is opened outside the OS shell (the portal has no /mqtt). {host} is the page's own host. The OS shell's broker wins when there is one.
